modEffects: When deflecting bullets (using the Omega variant of Move-By-Wire cyberware), the ricochets deal full damage instead of just half.
The first time during each scene the weapon would suffer the Damaged state, it ignores it instead.
Adds +1 base damage, or +2 damage for a 2-handed weapon.
The first parry attempt with the weapon only costs 1 instead of 2 AP each round.

The weapon can switch between its usual form and another melee or ranged weapon chosen upon acquiring this mod. Switching the forms requires 2 AP. The other form of the weapon can be modded separately, but both weapons lose a mod slot for “Transformable”, and the costs need to be spent on both.
The two chosen forms needs to be sensible - the GM is the final arbiter.
Such weapons tend to look bizarre and complicated, and any attempts to repair or modify them suffer a -2 pool penalty.
If you use the "Suppress / Distract" spending option against the target you just hit, it is twice as effective.
After one hour, remove the "Damaged" quality from the weapon.
The weapon gains Handling (1). If it already has it, increase its Handling by +1 instead.
The weapon gains Defensive (1, Melee). If it already has it, this mod has no effect.
Drawing or picking up the weapon only costs 1 instead of 3 AP.
The weapon gains the Injuring (3) quality. Not applicable to blunt weapons.

The weapon gains Concealed (2) if it is one-handed, or Concealed (3) if it is two-handed. If the weapon already has the quality, reduce it by 1 (to Minimum of 1).
In its folded form, the weapon appears like a regular item, suitcase or similar. Unfolding the weapon into its weapon-ready form requires spending 2 AP (this is in addition to drawing it).

The weapon gains "Pentrating (3)" (if it already has it, increase it by +2 instead).

Not applicable to blunt weapons.
Upon causing an injury roll, automatically cause a cyberware malfunction roll.
Gain the "Knocking" trigger option. It if already has it, the target has +1 difficulty to resist it.
